scope.question: Assess whether F1 or F2 can serve as a later third-family fallback from existing readable scripts, campaign records, reports, matrices, authorizations, and assets.
explicit_non_actions: no GPU allocation or queue submission

f1.why: The 15-cell F1 H1 design, 15 prepared inputs, jobs manifest, and calibrated observer are readable. The evaluator still has 15 missing runtime products, and the audited H1/H2/H3/G1 repair lineage is closed after retained hard failures; a same-class retry is not authorized.
f1.fallback_value: high input-preparation reuse; low immediate execution authority

f2.why: The static full-cup volume-hold scene has an independent design, a passed nominal canary, and a later v4 CPU-prepared 15-cell asset. However, one historical runtime cell failed hard static gates and the other 14 runtime products are missing; the candidate remains root-review-only and the global F1/F2 route closure denies action now.
f2.fallback_value: best surviving physical candidate if a genuinely new root-authorized definition is later accepted; no current T1/credit

f2_dynamic.why: The registered rotating-pour matrix was withdrawn before submission because the finite runtime envelope could not retain native identities through the 2.5 s gate. Later DBC canaries retained hard identity but remained event-censored; no dynamic promotion exists.

executive_verdict.resource_vs_authority: GPU memory availability is not the present blocker. Provenance, scientific hard gates, fixed denominators, root authorization, and Core reader/runtime evidence remain the blockers; this audit does not infer launch authority from available GPUs.

relevant_constraints: Core needs at least three mechanism families; F1/F2 are explicitly fallback routes after the prioritized F8 route.
F1 is described as dam-break/obstacle with native exclusions and runtime-domain repair still unresolved, followed by a complete reference study.
F2 is described as pour/catch with generation and diagnostic entrances, but static hold, moving cup wall, cup mouth, and numerical-reference integration remain missing.
Every qualification/canary/repair case remains qualification_only and cannot enter training or model selection.
A passing read/prepare path is not a T1 result; runtime evidence, fixed matrix completion, and the independent qualification gates are required.

Inspected static CLI/function entry points with rg and source reads.

feasibility.not_yet_proven: runtime numerical integrity, event completeness, Core dataset release, T1, material sidecar, or 32-case production coverage

entry_points.boundary: Preparation and job construction are distinct from execution; the run command is not authorized by this audit.
The observer/calibration contract is reusable; evaluate() cannot turn missing runtime products into qualification.

entry_points.current_gap: The raw F1 assets are XML/BI4/CSV/VTK, not a formal Core trajectory-HDF5 manifest.

prepared_inputs.interpretation: The prepared inputs can be inspected/revalidated as future input artifacts, but their embedded claim remains canary/preparation-only.

jobs_manifest.execution_status: prepared_only; canary gate required before qualification

reuse native exclusion and finite-wall root-cause clues
reuse terminal H3 mechanism evidence to exclude the old bottom-face repair lineage

authorization.future_reopen_condition: a genuinely new falsifiable physical Definition outside closed lineages, with a new scope/case/output namespace and fresh root review

gaps_before_formal_t1: Produce and root-review a genuinely new F1 physical Definition; changing CFL, observer, or output names is insufficient.

Close the new canary with zero missing native fluid IDs, zero nonfinite active values, zero closed-wall endpoint violations, zero saved-chord crossings, fixed initial mass, and a complete event window.
Execute and hash all 15 independent matrix runtime products; the current evaluator has 15 missing rows.
Bind each trajectory to a Core-readable HDF5 manifest, known_inputs, source Definition, solver/runtime identity, split, and immutable hashes.
Pass the registered spatial/temporal comparisons, actual-time-step and native-output cadence checks, canary gate, and independent campaign review.
gaps_before_core_adoption: Build at least the required 32 independent development cases for the selected F1 scope after numerical qualification; the 15 qualification rows are not the Core training product.
Complete material-sidecar, reader, split, model-evaluation, and reproducibility evidence without using qualification-only rows for training or normalization.

feasibility.not_yet_proven: all-cell runtime integrity, range/event qualification, formal Core release, rotating-cup transfer, or 32-case production coverage

gaps_before_formal_t1: Resolve the cell-00 cup boundary/open-mouth failure with a genuinely new, hash-bound physical Definition or root-approved repair outside the closed same-lineage retry policy.
Obtain the required root review; current static candidate and v4 preparation do not authorize solver/GPU/queue execution.
Obtain 15/15 independent runtime products and pass hard identity, finite/mass, closed-face/chord, open-cup escape, static event, spatial comparator, temporal comparator, and held-out checks.

Do not describe static F2 as rotating-cup, receiver-transfer, spill, or catchment qualification; those mechanisms require a separate successful scope.
